# pbs_sync_job (Resource)

Manages a PBS sync job.

Sync jobs pull backups from a remote PBS server to the local datastore, enabling off-site 
backup replication. Omit `remote` to create a local sync job that copies backups from 
another datastore on the same PBS (`remote_store` is then the local source datastore; 
requires PBS 3.3 or later). You can filter which backup groups to sync and control bandwidth usage 
with rate limiting. The `remove_vanished` option keeps the local copy synchronized 
by removing backups that no longer exist on the remote.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Pull backups from a remote PBS into a local datastore
resource "pbs_sync_job" "offsite" {
  id               = "offsite-pull"
  store            = "backups"
  remote           = pbs_remote.offsite_pbs.name
  remote_store     = "datastore1"
  remote_namespace = "prod"
  schedule         = "hourly"
  remove_vanished  = true
  rate_in          = "50M"
  comment          = "Pull production backups from offsite PBS"
}

# Local sync job: copy one datastore into another datastore on the same PBS
# (PBS >= 3.3). Omit `remote`; `remote_store` is the local source datastore.
resource "pbs_sync_job" "local_to_ext" {
  id              = "local-to-ext"
  store           = "ext"   # target datastore
  remote_store    = "local" # source datastore on this PBS
  schedule        = "daily"
  remove_vanished = true
  comment         = "local -> ext, daily"
}

# Push sync job: push local backups to a remote PBS (requires `remote`)
resource "pbs_sync_job" "push" {
  id             = "push-offsite"
  store          = "backups"
  remote         = pbs_remote.offsite_pbs.name
  remote_store   = "datastore1"
  sync_direction = "push"
  schedule       = "daily"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the sync job.
- `remote_store` (String) The datastore name on the remote server. For a local sync job (no `remote`), this is the local source datastore and must differ from `store`.
- `schedule` (String) When to run the sync job. Uses systemd calendar event format (e.g., `hourly`, `*:00/15`, `Mon,Wed,Fri 02:00`).
- `store` (String) The local datastore name where backups will be synced to.

### Optional

- `burst_in` (String) Inbound burst rate limit in PBS byte size format (e.g., `20M`). Leave empty for unlimited.
- `burst_out` (String) Outbound burst rate limit in PBS byte size format (e.g., `20M`). Leave empty for unlimited.
- `comment` (String) A comment describing this sync job.
- `encrypted_only` (Boolean) Only sync encrypted backups. Defaults to `false`.
- `group_filter` (List of String) List of backup group selectors using `group:<name>`, `type:<vm|ct|host>`, or `regex:<pattern>` syntax. Only matching groups will be synced.
- `max_depth` (Number) Maximum namespace depth that will be traversed when syncing. Must be greater than or equal to 0.
- `namespace` (String) Local namespace where backups will be stored. Optional; supports hierarchical namespaces such as `ns1/sub`.
- `owner` (String) Owner user ID for the synced backups. Optional.
- `rate_in` (String) Inbound transfer rate limit in PBS byte size format (e.g., `10M` for 10 MiB/s). Leave empty for unlimited.
- `rate_out` (String) Outbound transfer rate limit in PBS byte size format (e.g., `10M`). Leave empty for unlimited.
- `remote` (String) The remote server name (configured in PBS remotes). Omit for a local sync job that syncs between two datastores on the same PBS (requires PBS 3.3 or later). Required when `sync_direction` is `push`.
- `remote_namespace` (String) Remote namespace to sync from. Optional; leave empty to sync from the remote root namespace.
- `remove_vanished` (Boolean) Remove backups locally that no longer exist on the remote. Defaults to `false`.
- `resync_corrupt` (Boolean) Resync snapshots whose data is corrupt. Defaults to `false`.
- `run_on_mount` (Boolean) Run the job immediately after the datastore is mounted. Defaults to `false`.
- `sync_direction` (String) Direction of synchronization. Must be either `pull` (default) or `push`.
- `transfer_last` (Number) Only transfer backups newer than the last N seconds. Set to 0 to disable.
- `verified_only` (Boolean) Only sync backups that were verified successfully. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `digest` (String) Opaque digest returned by PBS for optimistic locking.
